const library = await getRadarrLibrary(config);\n  const existing = library.find(m => \n    m.title && m.title.toLowerCase() === title.toLowerCase()\n  );\n  \n  if (existing) {\n    return {\n };\n\n  const added = await addRadarrMovie(config, movieToAdd);\n  return {\n    ...added,\n    alreadyInLibrary: false\n  };\n}\n\nasync function handleTVRequest(config, title) {\n  // Check if
